0.original: What's a musicking station without handheld carrotlights? A <hex:021A020203>sad<hex:021A020103> musicking station. And Managingway won't stand for it.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to Managingway.

48.original: According to recent surveys, the availability of handheld carrotlights has dramatically increased overall musicking satisfaction.

49.original: But a review of data from the past three cycles reveals that we must increase production of said lights by six percent if we are to meet current demand.

50.original: I have asked Keepingway to procure additional supplies and begin assembly immediately, so could you offer them your assistance?

51.original: By my whiskers am I glad to see you! When Managingway told me how many lights we needed to make, I thought I might cry.

52.original: We're currently short on decorative parts, so could you handle those? The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.

53.original: We're currently short on handles, so could you craft some of those? The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.

54.original: We're currently short on glowy bits...um, the things that make the carrotlights light up? Y-You probably know better than I do! The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.

55.original: When you've finished, go and tell Managingway. I'll have the others start assembling from the pieces we have!

56.original: Thank you for your supply request. <blip> Please use what you have before asking for more─always clean your plate!

62.original: How goes carrotlight production? Have we reached our six percent?

63.original: Oh, thank goodness! With this, our Ways should be sufficiently supplied with carrotlights for the time being.

64.original: We have also received requests for a wider variety of colors, as well as improvements to the carrotlights' basic functionality. Exciting times await!

65.original: I hope I can count on your future assistance, but for now, please accept this small token of our appreciation.
